local.banner: LOCAL MODE — Data is stored on this device only. No server synchronisation.

page.title: Local data
page.description: Backup, restore and reset the data of this local mode (stored on this device only).
page.fallback: Durable browser storage is unavailable: data is kept in memory and will be lost when the tab is closed. Export a backup.
page.backupHelp: Downloads all local data as a JSON file. Keep it safe: it may contain fictitious or entered patient data.
page.restoreHelp: Replaces all local data with a backup file. The file is checked before anything changes.
page.restoreConfirm: All current local data will be replaced. This cannot be undone: export a backup first if needed.
page.resetHelp: Erases all local data and reloads the initial fictitious dataset.
page.resetConfirm: Everything entered on this device will be permanently erased, then the demo dataset is reloaded.
